admission.justification: Both shapes were live (old sidebar vs tree); every later rail change must keep one-line rows and keep texts out of the sidebar.

alternatives.option: One-line family and invariant navigation, each subject's changed-location rows and up to two counted closed group rows, with one short reason chosen by the active sort. Changed remains the default with All one switch away; complete statements, rationales, reasons and records remain in the reading column.
alternatives.reason: D48's one-line navigation density and main-page record texts remain. Approved MIK-R86 v2 rules 1-5 add changed-location rows, two group exceptions and one sort-dependent reason while preserving the Changed default; MIK-R89 v2 rule 3 keeps one shared tree/reading order.

alternatives.option: Keep the prose sidebar with guarantee/member statements, breakdown lines and per-row disclosures in the rail.
alternatives.reason: D48 rules it out: 24,713 px and 183 disclosures beside a main page showing the same texts.
alternatives.reconsider_when: A named reader workflow proves it must judge change kinds from inside the rail without opening the main page.

consequences: Every family, subject, changed-location and group row stays one line. A row has one short active-sort reason; a family may also say kept. Complete statements and record explanations stay in the reading column.

A subject has up to two counted closed group rows for unchanged and not-comparable locations, drawn only for nonzero groups. Activating one opens and scrolls to that group in the reading column; it expands no rows in the tree.

Changed remains the default, All is one switch away, and a deterministic active sort orders the tree and reading column together. The rejected prose-sidebar alternative and its recorded reconsideration condition remain historical decision evidence.
context: Developer direction D48 on the L86 reviewer sidebar (2026-10-04): a simple tree of one-line entries with the full lines in the main page, everything collapsed open by default, and the installed primitives reused instead of redeveloped. Approved MIK-R86 v2 rules 1-5 and MIK-R89 v2 rule 3 amend the current row and group account for L89; the original D48 sidebar observation remains historical.
